text: Writeup on the Stark Distribution invoice discrepancy (BIL-31): when a robot was swapped mid-cycle (RMA + replacement), we prorated the removed unit by calendar days but the new unit by billing-period days. Stark's July invoice was overcharged $2,184.60 across 64 robots. Fix normalizes both to robot-days in the period. https://linear.northwind.dev/issue/BIL-31
Nice find. Did any other customers hit this?
Ran a query on the billing DB for every swap since January. Only Stark had swaps that straddled a cycle boundary. Credit memo goes out with their August invoice; support has the ticket.
Another point for the PayStream migration. Let's make sure there's a regression test for swaps.
Added three: swap mid-cycle, swap on boundary, double swap. Deploying the fix at 19:00 UTC.
Is there a reason the API returns 204 vs 200 on robot heartbeat? Asking before I 'fix' it.
Yes, firmware 2.6 and older treat any body as a command payload. Please don't fix it :)
